How Structure Shapes Life Pattern
Life operation asks whether support, output, resources, responsibility
and relationships can circulate as one system.
For life operation, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at
about 46.2%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Wealth, and Direct Officer. It also
connects to Seven Killings pattern path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by
relationships between pillar positions such as self anchor ↔ later expression and
environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 4 themes considered across the
chart, so this is best read together with the rest of the chart.
Consider support and demand together rather than isolating one favorable symbol. A
visible candidate does not become an established pattern merely because its name
appears in a diagram. Where a condition remains open, keep the corresponding
conclusion open too. In experience, compare a demanding situation with and without
practical support. This comparison can sharpen your question about the structure
without turning the chart into a verdict about what you can achieve.
The key is not which function wins permanently, but whether support, output, resources and responsibility can
return to a sustainable circulation across changing periods.
